<!-- pr-reviewer: 82f132ca5d573637ee2d4cf30525a22afcdf3e15 -->
**Verdict: Needs rework.** The door works: the status strip shows the Debug info only when developer mode is on and the pipeline reports work. This head does not pass the review.

The lane built this head: trial merge of 82f132ca5 with origin/main fac6c8e8d, clean, no CRLF changes.

Gate: camcraft-ui, six binaries, 200 tests, green (structural 51, ui_panel 28, ui_app 28, ui_menu 46, ui_tree 28, ui_command 19). camcraft-app lib: 13072 tests green. Clippy: green. The UI did not run in a window; the tests drive the real app headless.

Independence: this head contains a commit co-authored by mkinney, and his marker is not an independent review of it. This review is the independent one.

Blockers:
1. No test fails on the old code. A fix test must fail before the fix and pass after it.
2. The fold and close paths have no coverage. This PR deleted the two tests that covered them. It added no replacement test. See crates/ui/tests/fold_and_highlight.rs.
3. One test passes on every run. It does not check a value.

Fix: restore the fold and close coverage with tests that check values, and add one test that fails on the old code.

Non-blocking: the head now conflicts with the newer main. The author must merge main and push (refresh at merge time).

Correction to the review above: this head is MERGEABLE with the current main 3c7385fba. The "conflicts" note was taken from an older state and does not apply. The verdict and the three blockers stand.

<!-- review-cost: 82f132ca5d573637ee2d4cf30525a22afcdf3e15 -->
effort:high (P4 #2174) · independent lane review · ui six binaries + app lib run on merged tree

Review fix on head 41f25f1805d189e55bee6d976ccb50b01b6502c6. Only tests changed. No production code changed. The PR stays a draft.

Blocker 1 (no test fails on old code). Three new tests and one old test now fail when the door goes back to the old behaviour. Proof: in the worktree I put back `state.debug_info_open = !state.debug_info_open;` in the status strip door (`panes.rs`) and ran `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib debug_info`. Result: 4 failed, 2 passed. The failed tests are:
- `the_debug_info_door_docks_a_tab_beside_properties` (layout.rs:183, no tab in the dock)
- `closing_the_debug_info_tab_clears_the_flag_and_the_panel` (layout.rs:198)
- `the_docked_debug_info_copy_button_copies_the_report` (layout.rs:218, no Copy button)
- `the_debug_info_panel_is_present_docked_and_undocked` (layout.rs:149)

I restored the file after the run. With the production code, all 6 pass.

Blocker 2 (fold and close coverage). The old window had a collapse button and a close button. A dock tab has no collapse button, so the fold test has no new form. I replaced the two deleted tests with these tests that check values:
- `closing_the_debug_info_tab_clears_the_flag_and_the_panel`: the dock removes the tab (the tab X). The flag `debug_info_open` becomes false, the Copy button is gone, and the door opens the panel again.
- `the_docked_debug_info_copy_button_copies_the_report`: the old Copy test, now for the docked panel. It checks the clipboard text starts with `CamCraft ` and has the `Frame rate:` line. It checks the status text.
- `the_debug_info_door_docks_a_tab_beside_properties`: the tab is in the same leaf as Properties and no command is queued.

Count of `#[test]` in the debug info area: before this commit 4 (2 in `debug_info_tests.rs`, 1 in `tests/layout.rs`, plus the frame-rate unit tests are counted separately: 3). After: 2 in `debug_info_tests.rs`, 4 in `tests/layout.rs`. The fold test cannot return: there is no fold in a tab.

Blocker 3 (a test that always passes). `the_report_gives_the_frame_rate_or_says_idle` only checked the idle text of a fresh state. It is now `the_report_gives_the_frame_rate_value_then_idle_when_stale`. It feeds 16 ms frames for 1 s and asserts the line starts with `Frame rate: 62 fps (16.0 ms per frame)`. Then it asserts the line says idle 2 s after the last frame.

Tests run: `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib debug_info`, 6 passed. Not run: the other UI suites, clippy, the GUI. The new code adds no per-frame work.
Correction of the count above. Debug info tests in `debug_info_tests.rs` and `tests/layout.rs`: 3 before this commit, 6 after (2 + 4). The 3 frame-rate unit tests in `frame_rate.rs` did not change.

Correction to review comment 6937156826 at head 82f132ca5. The lane checked the citations in that review against the real trees.

Blocker 2 names the wrong file. crates/ui/tests/fold_and_highlight.rs does not exist on main or on this head. The removed test code is in crates/ui/src/egui_app/debug_info_tests.rs (65 lines removed). The concern stands in part: the close path is covered again by the new test in crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/layout.rs. The fold path has no twin, because a dock tab has no collapse button (maintainer check). If the fold concept is gone by design, blocker 2 is answered by the design, not by a new test.

Blockers 1 and 3 stand as written. The verdict needs-rework stands.

<!-- review-cost: effort:medium · escalated: no -->
The review ran on the trial merge with main (f887908f9). The merge is clean.
Result: needs rework. Three blockers.

1. The door does not open on a document with operations. A pointer click at the
centre of the Debug info door is swallowed there. The "{ops_n} Operations"
label covers the door centre (crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1624-1625;
measured at 1280x720: door rect [1256,691]-[1272,709], label rect
[1249.9,695]-[1302,705]). The door works at its top edge and on the blank
shell. The overlay code exists on main too; this feature depends on it. Fix the
overlap: clamp the inner layout, or register the label before the button. Add
one door test on a seeded document; the present door tests all use
blank_harness().
2. The wasm32 build does not compile. crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs:26-28 gates
`frame_rate` for wasm but not `frame_watch`. frame_watch.rs:12 reads
`super::frame_rate::LOG_EVERY`. crates/ui/src/state.rs:1671 and
crates/ui/src/state.rs:2091 name `crate::egui_app::frame_rate::FrameRate`
without a cfg, and state.rs builds for wasm (crates/ui/src/lib.rs:67).
debug_info.rs:72 reads that field. Give the field and the constant a wasm home,
or gate the users. The wasm check stops earlier in flecs-sys on this machine;
the evidence for this blocker is static.
3. The merged tree is red. `page_layout::layout_window_debug_info` fails:
"Debug info window: not open"
(crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs:236). The PR removed the window
but did not update that layout test. The refit rule (#1953): the PR updates its
page's layout test.

Gate on the merged tree: camcraft-ui --lib = 1022 pass, 1 fail (item 3),
6 ignored. Clippy `--all-targets -D warnings` is clean. The new door,
tab-close, Copy, frame_rate and frame_watch tests pass. The tab-close test
calls `dock.remove_tab(path)` directly
(crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/layout.rs:200); the X press is covered only by
the Browser tab's test. Note: the label text reads "1 Operations" for one
operation; a P7 issue is filed.

Review fix pushed. New head: 878378d7460477471abd64252ccb4055e36da3c0 (merge of origin/main, clean, then one fix commit).

Blocker 1, door overlap. The citation was right. The "N Operations" label sat after the status line in the inner left-to-right layout. The line fills the space that is left, so the label ran onto the door. Change: the label is now placed before the status line, in the right-to-left layout of `panes.rs`. Pinned by `layout::the_debug_info_door_opens_at_its_centre_on_a_document_with_operations`: a pointer press at the door centre on the seeded document (it has operations) opens the panel. The test fails on the old `panes.rs` and passes on the new one.

Blocker 2, wasm32. The citation was right in effect. The PR inserted `frame_rate` under the existing wasm `cfg`, so `frame_rate` was gated and `frame_watch` was not. Change in `egui_app/mod.rs`: `frame_rate` has no `cfg` (it uses `camcraft_app::clock::Instant`, and `state.rs` holds it). `frame_watch` is gated off wasm again, as on main. Its users are `shell_window.rs` and `shell_window/frame.rs` only. The wasm check stops in flecs-sys (clang for flecs_rust.c), so this evidence is static.

Blocker 3, `page_layout::layout_window_debug_info`. The test now opens the dock tab with `LayoutRequest::ToggleDebugInfo`. It asserts that the leaf is inside the screen and that the Copy button is inside the leaf. The coverage is kept.

Results, debug, `-j 4`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1030 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not exercised: the wasm32 build, the pixel snapshots (release lane), the GUI. The PR stays a draft.

**Verdict: clean. No blockers. Label set: merge-ready.**
Delta review of the commits after 41f25f180 (heads 878378d746 and 5e56f1bde): one merge of main, whose remerge-diff is empty, and one hand fix commit. All three earlier blockers are closed.
1. Door click: in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/panes.rs:1615-1619` the "Operations" label is now a child of the right-to-left sequence, placed before the status line. The status line fills only what is left, so the label no longer runs past it onto the door. A new test clicks the door centre on a seeded document with operations and asserts the panel opens (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/layout.rs:189`, "the_debug_info_door_opens_at_its_centre_on_a_document_with_operations"). It passes.
2. wasm gating: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mod.rs:27` keeps `frame_rate` ungated and `:28-29` gates `frame_watch` with `#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]`. `frame_rate.rs:8` imports `camcraft_app::clock::Instant`, which is itself gated (std on native, web_time on wasm). The `frame_rate` field and initializer in `crates/ui/src/state.rs` are ungated and consistent. All `frame_watch` users sit in the native-only `shell_window` tree (`mod.rs:212-213`).
3. Layout test: `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/page_layout.rs:232-236` now sends `LayoutRequest::ToggleDebugInfo`, asserts `debug_info_open`, and checks the Debug info dock leaf. The test passes. The PR changes no snapshot PNG.
Gate (local, this head): camcraft-ui lib 1030 passed, 0 failed, 6 ignored; the two layout tests above included; clippy `-D warnings` clean.
Notes (not blockers): on a wasm build the frame-rate row can read "idle", because `shell_web.rs` does not feed frames to the counter; the slow-frame log quiet window now matches the frame-rate line's own rate limit rule.
